about.label: About
about.story1: My name is Dejan. I'm 55 years old. By trade, I'm a car mechanic. A man who spent his entire life working with his hands, in grease, in noise, in the real world.
about.story2: And that's exactly why I understood something many never do: Technology is not about machines. Technology is about people.
about.mission: To create digital systems that bring clarity and harmony into everyday life.
about.vision: A world where technology supports humans — not the other way around.

principles.title: Human-Centered Intelligence
principles.body: Every decision starts with a single question: how does this feel to the person using it? Technology must earn its place in a human life.

principles.title: Warm & Calm Technology
principles.body: We reject noise, clutter, and urgency. Our products are designed to slow you down — in the best possible way.

principles.title: Systems That Bring Order
principles.body: Complexity is the enemy of clarity. We build systems that quietly handle the hard parts so you never have to.

about.manifest1: We believe that every person — regardless of age, background, or expertise — deserves technology that respects them.
about.manifest2: Not technology that overwhelms. Not technology that manipulates. Not technology that replaces the human touch.
about.manifest3: Technology like sunrise — quiet, inevitable, and full of possibility.
